2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a performance issue on large multi-threaded workloads where the mmap lock is contended, causing readers like /proc/PID/cmdline or process_vm_readv() to stall even when the target memory is resident. The solution involves adding an unlocked variant of untagged_addr_remote(), which masks the remote address against the target mm without asserting the lock.
